subject: MSA & Order Form: SOC2 assertions + pen test window
messages:
From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@medalign.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: MedAlign Legal <legal@medalign.com>, Amina Khan <amina.khan@medalign.com>
Date: 2025-10-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MSA & Order Form: SOC2 assertions + pen test window

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the demo last week. Legal asked me to follow up so we can lock the MSA/order form language for audit rights before the end of Q4. Two quick asks from our side:

1) Can you provide an "assertion map" linking Redwood's SOC 2 controls and evidence artifacts to our control owners? We need a short table we can attach to our compliance file.
2) We need to agree a pen-test window and a small scope carveout for our side (third-party connectors). Our security team prefers a 2–3 week test window in Nov/Dec with a 48–72 hour notice for any scheduled tests.

Also please list what evidence you can commit to (logs, SOC 2 report, key configuration screenshots, ephemeral access process) and an expected cadence for sharing those artifacts during onboarding. I've attached our standard audit request form for reference.

Can we get a proposed plan and any preferred MSA language redlines by EOD Thursday? If legal needs a small call, happy to set one.

Regards,
Jordan Price
Head of Security Programs | MedAlign Health

Attachment: medalign_audit_request.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@medalign.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-10-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form: SOC2 assertions + pen test window

Hi Jordan — thanks for the clear ask and the form.

Attached is a first-pass assertion map (redline_assertion_map.xlsx) that ties our SOC 2 assertions to the likely artifacts we can deliver during onboarding. High level: we can commit to providing the latest SOC 2 Type II report, a contextual evidence manifest (screenshots/config snippets for tenant setup), audited access logs (30/90 days depending on plan), and a documented ephemeral access process for inspection.

For the pen test window I propose we target a staging window of Nov 10–24 with a 48-hour notice for the active engagement start. Ben, can you confirm whether we need to push to 72-hour blackout for deploys? Grace, will you capture the evidence cadence in the onboarding playbook (weekly drops for 3 weeks + final signoff)?

On the contract side: Laura — please review the MSA audit-rights paragraph and the order form addendum I’ve sketched in the spreadsheet. My ask to legal: 1) narrow the inspection boundaries to the tenant and ephemeral staging instance, 2) require a mutual deployment blackout window, and 3) add a short acceptance clause for evidence handback timing so that both sides have a clear SLA for artifact delivery.

If that works for MedAlign, Jordan, we can send a clean redline and schedule a 30-minute call Thursday to finalize.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redline_assertion_map.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@medalign.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-10-22T09:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form: SOC2 assertions + pen test window

On Tue, Oct 21, 2025 at 9:12 AM Jordan Price <jordan.price@medalign.com> wrote:
> Hi Karthik —
> 
> Thanks for the demo last week...

Quick technical flags from security/ops:

- We prefer a 72-hour deploy freeze leading into the active test window to avoid incidental failures. If Nov 10–24 is the window, recommend freeze Nov 8–Nov 26.
- Pen test should run against our isolated staging tenant; no production credentials or live-PHI traffic should be involved.
- Scope: exclude any third-party managed connectors (explicitly call them out in the order form). We can include sample endpoints for targeted tests but not vendor-owned subcomponents.
- We will provide a pen_test_scope.pdf with the suggested exclusions and a shortlist of high-level test types (auth, token handling, KV-cache isolation, data exfiltration attempts).

Also propose MSA wording edits (high level):
1) Add line limiting forensic access to ephemeral staging instances unless subpoenaed.
2) Add 48–72 hour mutually agreed notice for active tests.
3) Call out a 30-day remediation timeline for medium/high findings with an option to extend for joint critical items.

If everyone is OK with these constraints I’ll prepare the technical annex.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Security Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: pen_test_scope.pdf (PDF, 90KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@medalign.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-10-23T16:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form: SOC2 assertions + pen test window

Thanks all — consolidated legal view below.

Summary of proposed contract path (high level):
- MSA: add a narrow inspection clause that limits audit rights to the customer’s tenant and Cedar-staging equivalents; require a written scope and 48–72 hour notice; forbid production traffic/credentials unless explicitly defined in the order form.
- Order Form Addendum: include an evidence manifest attachment (the assertion map) and a pen-test annex that enumerates excluded third-party components.
- Acceptance/SLAs: we will commit to an evidence turnback SLA of 3 business days for routine artifacts referenced in the assertion map; for forensic requests we propose a 10-business-day window. These will be reflected as service commitments in the addendum.

Turnaround and next steps:
1) Ben to finalize the technical annex (pen_test_scope.pdf) with explicit exclusion language.
2) Karthik to confirm proposed window (we have Nov 10–24); if Ben needs Nov 8–26 freeze, call that out now.
3) I will prepare redline language for the MSA and a short addendum for the order form. Legal will aim for a 3 business day first-pass redline turnaround once Ben’s annex is attached.

Jordan — if MedAlign agrees to those operational constraints (staging-only, 48–72 hour notice, explicit exclusions), legal is comfortable proceeding with the limited inspection language and the order form addendum. Please confirm and we’ll circulate a clean redline + Docusign path.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
